title.en: Houthis Target Riyadh as Saudi Arabia Reports Missile Attack Attempt
title.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）瞄準利雅德（Riyadh） 沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）指控飛彈攻擊企圖

summary.en: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital Riyadh with ballistic missiles, with a reported strike on a fuel depot at the airport causing delays. Saudi Arabia states it shot down the missile aimed at the capital. The Iranian-backed group is also fighting Saudi-backed forces in Yemen to expand territory.
summary.zh-TW: 胡塞武裝（Houthis）宣稱以彈道飛彈瞄準沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都利雅德（Riyadh），機場燃料庫據報遭擊中導致延誤。沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）表示擊落飛彈。伊朗支持的該組織同時在也門（Yemen）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持的政府軍交戰，試圖擴張領土。

body.en: Lede: Houthis claim to have targeted the Saudi capital Riyadh with ballistic missiles while engaged in territorial expansion efforts in Yemen. What happened: According to BBC World, Houthis stated they targeted the Saudi capital with ballistic missiles and a reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday. Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital. NPR World reports Saudi Arabia said Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time its capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels. NYT World notes the Iranian-backed militia was engaged in fierce battles with Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen on Sunday as it seeks to maintain momentum in the war. Why it matters: The reported missile attempt marks renewed direct threats to Saudi territory amid ongoing Yemen conflict, highlighting rising tensions between Houthis and Saudi Arabia. Sources agree/disagree: All sources describe the missile incident involving Riyadh and Houthi actions in Yemen without conflicting details on events. Still uncertain: Exact outcomes of the reported airport delays and specific battle results in Yemen remain unconfirmed beyond the provided reports.
body.zh-TW: 導言：胡塞武裝（Houthis）宣稱以彈道飛彈瞄準沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都利雅德（Riyadh），同時在也門（Yemen）進行領土擴張行動。 事件經過：根據BBC World報導，胡塞武裝（Houthis）表示以彈道飛彈瞄準沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）首都，利雅德（Riyadh）機場燃料庫據報於週六遭擊中導致延誤。沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）表示擊落瞄準首都的彈道飛彈。NPR World報導沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）指也門胡塞叛軍試圖以彈道飛彈攻擊利雅德（Riyadh），這是首都自與伊朗支持叛軍戰事升溫以來首次遭瞄準。NYT World指出伊朗支持的民兵週日在也門（Yemen）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）支持的政府軍激烈交戰，試圖維持戰爭勢頭。 重要性：據報飛彈企圖標誌對沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）領土的直接威脅再度出現，凸顯胡塞武裝（Houthis）與沙烏地阿拉伯（Saudi Arabia）之間緊張局勢上升。 來源一致／分歧：所有來源均描述涉及利雅德（Riyadh）的飛彈事件及胡塞武裝（Houthis）在也門（Yemen）的行動，事件細節無衝突。 仍未確定：利雅德（Riyadh）機場延誤的確切結果及也門（Yemen）具體戰鬥結果，除報導外仍未確認。

summary.en: Nato welcomes a Greenland deal between Denmark and the US after months of threats from Donald Trump to annex the territory. Why it matters: The agreement follows prolonged tensions involving annexation threats and receives support from Nato. title.en: Meta Muse AI Assistant Surveils Users More Than It Helps
title.zh-TW: Meta（Meta） Muse AI 助理監控用戶多於協助

summary.en: Meta's Muse AI app accesses Messages, Calendar, and Notes on Mac while opting users into data collection for training. It also prompts sharing of bank, email, and passport details, raising privacy issues despite its assistant capabilities.
summary.zh-TW: Meta（Meta） Muse AI 應用程式可在 Mac 上存取訊息、日曆與筆記，並將用戶納入 AI 訓練資料收集，還提示分享銀行、電子郵件與護照資訊，儘管具助理功能但引發隱私疑慮。

body.en: Lede: Meta's Muse AI assistant draws attention for its surveillance features rather than helpfulness. What happened: The Verge reports Muse as an effective AI assistant yet creepy due to its Mac app accessing Messages, Calendar, and Notes. Wired AI notes the app continues Meta’s trend of opting users into data collection for AI training and nudges sharing of bank account, email, and passport information. Jason Aten shared screenshots on Threads of Muse questioning a Messages conversation. Why it matters: The access and data prompts highlight ongoing privacy concerns with Meta products integrating AI. Sources agree/disagree: Both outlets describe Muse's data practices and creepy elements without conflicting details. Still uncertain: Exact user opt-in flows and data usage scope remain unclear from the reports.

summary.en: Ineos founder and Manchester United owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe told BBC he has lost confidence in the UK due to high taxes and high immigration. He described the country as on the slide and called for more North Sea investment. A Labour chair stated he lost moral high ground after becoming a tax exile.

body.en: Lede: Ineos founder Sir Jim Ratcliffe, owner of Manchester United, stated he has lost confidence in the UK. What happened: Speaking to BBC Business, Ratcliffe cited a combination of high taxes and high immigration as reasons for his view that the country is on the slide. He also called for more investment in the North Sea. A separate BBC Business report noted a Labour chair's comment that Ratcliffe has lost moral high ground after becoming a tax exile. Why it matters: The statements from the billionaire businessman highlight concerns over UK economic policies and their impact on business leaders. Sources agree/disagree: Both BBC Business reports cover Ratcliffe's loss of confidence and related comments without conflicting details. Still uncertain: No further details on specific policy changes or responses from UK officials are provided in the sources.

summary.en: Former MIT researchers now at IBM leverage MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab experience to advance AI and quantum applications. body.en:

title.zh-TW: 莫斯科（Moscow）在俄羅斯（Russia）選舉最後一天遭數百架無人機襲擊

summary.en: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones at Moscow in the largest reported attack on the Russian capital, coinciding with the final day of Russian parliamentary elections. Moscow's mayor stated 450 drones were downed with two deaths and damage to an oil refinery and residential building. Sources note over 1,000 drones fired at Russia overall and mention of a new Ukrainian ballistic missile.
summary.zh-TW: 烏克蘭（Ukraine）向莫斯科（Moscow）發射數百架無人機，這是俄羅斯（Russia）首都遭報導最大規模攻擊，正值俄羅斯議會選舉最後一天。莫斯科市長表示擊落450架無人機，造成兩人死亡及煉油廠和住宅受損。來源提及對俄羅斯總計發射逾千架無人機，並提到烏克蘭新彈道飛彈。

body.en: Lede: Moscow faced its largest reported drone assault from Ukraine on the final day of Russian elections. What happened: Ukraine fired hundreds of drones targeting Moscow and other Russian areas, with Moscow's mayor reporting 450 drones downed overnight. Two people died and damage occurred at a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building. NPR reported over 1,000 drones launched at Russia total. NYT noted Ukraine's use of a newly developed ballistic missile. Why it matters: The scale of the attack on the capital during elections highlights intensified Ukrainian strikes on Russian territory, including annexed regions where Russia held parliamentary votes. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm a major drone wave on Moscow tied to election timing. BBC and NPR cite mayor's statements on downed drones and damage. NYT adds ballistic missile detail absent elsewhere. Still uncertain: Exact total drones launched and full extent of damage or casualties beyond the mayor's report remain unspecified across outlets.
body.zh-TW: 導言：莫斯科（Moscow）在俄羅斯（Russia）選舉最後一天面臨烏克蘭（Ukraine）報導最大規模無人機襲擊。 事件經過：烏克蘭向莫斯科及其他俄羅斯地區發射數百架無人機，莫斯科市長表示夜間擊落450架。兩人死亡，莫斯科煉油廠和一棟住宅樓受損。NPR報導對俄羅斯總計發射逾千架無人機。NYT提及烏克蘭使用新開發彈道飛彈。 重要性：首都遭大規模攻擊正值選舉期間，凸顯烏克蘭對俄羅斯領土包括被併吞地區加強打擊，俄羅斯在該地區舉行議會投票。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源確認莫斯科遭重大無人機波襲擊且與選舉時間相關。BBC與NPR引用市長關於擊落無人機及損害的說法。NYT補充其他來源未提的彈道飛彈細節。 仍不確定：除市長報告外，發射無人機確切總數及損害或傷亡完整範圍在各媒體中仍未具體說明。

disagreements.en: Sources differ on drone numbers with BBC citing 450 downed and NPR stating over 1,000 fired at Russia; BBC alone reports two deaths; NYT uniquely mentions a new ballistic missile.
disagreements.zh-TW: 來源在無人機數量上分歧，BBC提及擊落450架，NPR稱對俄羅斯發射逾千架；僅BBC報導兩人死亡；NYT獨家提及新彈道飛彈。
